intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Welcome to Eazy! This guide covers everything you need to take full control of your finances. Navigate the tabs to discover each feature — from registering transactions to advanced automation with Smart Rules.
intro.tip: Tip: Start by adding your bank accounts and registering your first transaction!

dashboard.title: Main Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your financial command center — see everything at a glance.

points.1: Summary Cards: Total balance, monthly income and expenses updated in real time.
points.2: Monthly Chart: Visualize how your balance evolved over the past months.
points.3: Expenses by Category: Identify which categories consume most of your money.
points.4: Financial Score: A score from 0–100 that measures your overall financial health.
points.5: Month-end Forecast: Predicts your balance based on recurring transactions.

dashboard.tip: Use Shadow Mode to simulate a big purchase before making it!
dashboard.example: Example: If food expenses are consistently high, consider creating a budget for that category.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The heart of the system — register every financial movement accurately.

points.1: Add: Click '+ Add Transaction' to quickly record income or expenses.
points.2: Import: Upload bank files (OFX, Excel, CSV) to import hundreds of transactions at once.
points.3: Recurring: Configure transactions that repeat automatically (subscriptions, salary, rent).
points.4: Installments: Split a purchase across several months automatically.
points.5: AI Scan: Photograph a receipt and let the AI fill in the details automatically.

transactions.tip: Use Smart Rules to automatically categorize imported transactions.
transactions.example: Example: Import your credit card statement and all transactions will be categorized automatically using your rules.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Powerful tools to organize your financial present and future.
planning.budgets: Budgets: Set monthly spending limits per category. You get a real-time alert when approaching the limit.
planning.goals: Goals: Set a target amount and date (e.g., Japan trip for $5,000 by December). Track progress with visual charts.
planning.debt: Debts: Use the Snowball method to simulate and plan credit card and loan payoff.
planning.subscriptions: Subscriptions: Control all your recurring fixed expenses (streaming, gym, insurance) in one place.
planning.challenges: Challenges: Create gamified savings challenges — e.g., 'No food delivery for 7 days'.
planning.tip: The Rollover Budget feature carries unspent amounts forward to the next month.
planning.example: Example: Set a $500 budget for Food. When you reach 80%, you'll get an automatic alert.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Analyze your finances in depth and identify opportunities.
reports.content: Reports offer detailed charts on your spending habits. You can filter by period, category and account to get a complete picture of your financial health.

points.1: Financial Flow: See exactly where your money comes from and where it goes.
points.2: Period Comparison: Compare current month vs. previous month and same month last year.
points.3: Export PDF: Download a complete financial report to share or archive.
points.4: Send by Email: Receive the report directly in your inbox.
points.5: Smart Insights: Automatic alerts when a category spending is above your average.

reports.tip: Use the comparison view to identify months where you overspent.
reports.example: Example: In the comparison view, if Food in March is 40% higher than February, it signals an unusual spending.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Manage all your financial sources in one place.
accounts.content: Register your checking accounts, savings, credit cards, cash, and investments. Eazy calculates balances automatically based on your transactions.

points.1: Multiple Accounts: Checking, savings, credit card, cash, investment or loan.
points.2: Automatic Balance: Calculated in real time based on all transactions.
points.3: Credit Card Invoice: See the outstanding invoice value for each credit card.
points.4: Currency: Each account can have a different currency (BRL, USD, EUR, etc.).
points.5: Reorder: Drag and drop to organize accounts in your preferred order.

accounts.tip: Set the initial balance when creating an account so the current balance is always accurate.
accounts.example: Example: Create a 'Nubank' account of type Credit Card, set the limit as initial balance, and see the invoice updated automatically.

goals.title: Goals and Targets
goals.description: Turn your dreams into concrete, achievable plans.

points.1: Create Goal: Set a name, target amount and date (e.g., 'Japan Trip — $8,000 — December').
points.2: Progress: Visual bar showing percentage achieved and amount remaining.
points.3: Allocation: Reserve specific amounts from your accounts directly to the goal.
points.4: Automatic: Each allocation is recorded as a transaction in your history.
points.5: Celebrate: When you reach 100%, Eazy celebrates with you! 🎉

goals.tip: Create a separate savings account exclusively for goals to make tracking easier.
goals.example: Example: Set aside $300/month toward a Japan trip goal of $3,600 for a 12-month plan.

shared.title: Shared Finances
shared.description: Manage family or couple finances together in real time.
shared.content: Invite your partner, spouse or business partner via a secure one-time link. Once connected, you both see and can edit the same transactions, categories, accounts and goals.

points.1: Secure Invite: Generate a link that expires after first use.
points.2: Real-time Sync: Changes made by one person appear immediately for the other.
points.3: Shared Control: Both can add, edit and delete transactions.
points.4: Author Tag: Transactions show who added them — 'Created by partner'.
points.5: Ideal for: Couples, families, or business partners sharing expenses.

shared.tip: Keep categories organized so both people can find transactions easily.
shared.example: Example: You add the grocery expense on your phone. Your partner sees it immediately on theirs.

rules.title: Smart Rules
rules.description: Automate your financial organization and save time.
rules.content: Create automatic categorization rules based on keywords. Every time a transaction description matches a keyword, Eazy categorizes it automatically.

points.1: Create Rule: Define a keyword (e.g., 'Uber') and its category (Transport).
points.2: Auto-categorize: Applied automatically when adding or importing transactions.
points.3: Priority: Custom rules take precedence over the built-in keyword map.
points.4: Import Power: Import 200 transactions from your bank — all categorized instantly.
points.5: AI Suggestion: Eazy suggests saving a rule when you repeatedly categorize the same description.

rules.tip: After importing your first bank statement, create rules for your most frequent merchants.
rules.example: Example: Rule 'ifood' → Food. Rule 'Nubank' → Credit Card. Now every import is automatic!

challenges.title: Savings Challenges
challenges.description: Gamify your financial discipline and prove to yourself you can do it.

points.1: Choose a Template: 'No delivery for 7 days', 'No clothes for 30 days', and more.
points.2: Create Custom: Set your own category, target and duration.
points.3: Automatic Tracking: Eazy monitors your transactions and alerts you to violations.
points.4: Results: See how much you spent vs. how much you saved during the challenge.
points.5: Motivation: Completed challenges add to your financial discipline history.

challenges.tip: Start with a short 7-day challenge to build the habit before committing to longer ones.
challenges.example: Example: 'No Leisure for 14 days' — if you spend on cinema or streaming during the period, you'll be notified immediately.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.

items.q1: Why doesn't my balance match my bank statement?
items.a1: Make sure you've added all transactions and set the correct initial balance when creating the account. Use 'Recalculate Balances' in Settings if needed.
items.q2: How do I delete a recurring transaction?
items.a2: Go to Transactions, find the recurring transaction and click delete. You can choose to delete only that occurrence or all future ones.
items.q3: Can I use Eazy on my phone?
items.a3: Yes! Install the app directly from the browser — click the install icon in the address bar or use the 'Install App' option.
items.q4: How do I import with automatic categorization?
items.a4: First create your Smart Rules in Settings → Smart Rules. Then import the file in Transactions → Upload File. All matching rules are applied automatically.
items.a5: Yes. Your data is stored exclusively in your Firebase account, fully encrypted. We never access your financial information.
items.q6: How does credit card management work?
items.a6: Create an account of type 'Credit Card'. The current invoice is automatically calculated from your expenses. You can transfer to pay the bill.
items.a7: Shadow Mode lets you add simulated transactions to see how they would affect your balance — without those expenses appearing in your real history.
items.q8: Can I use the app without internet?
items.a8: Yes! After the first load, Eazy works offline. Changes are synced automatically when the connection is restored.
